content.short: TxNerd is a specialised Cardano blockchain transaction analysis platform that automatically imports, categorises, and exports
content.description:
TxNerd is a Cardano transaction analysis platform that imports, categorises, and exports wallet transactions to CSV format for cryptocurrency tax reporting. It bridges the gap between Cardano's blockchain and major tax software platforms like Recap and Awaken that don't support Cardano natively.

The platform specialises exclusively in Cardano, handling its technical complexities to provide accurate transaction classification. Users can import transactions via stake addresses, set up custom categorisation rules, manage wallet address books, detect transfers between their own wallets, and add tags or comments to transactions. It tracks everything from ADA transfers to native tokens, NFTs, staking rewards, and DeFi activity across multiple wallets.
